description: This Java class `FeignAccountHelper` provides helper methods to create and retrieve financial accounts (asset, liability, income, expense) in a Fineract-based system using a feign client. It encapsulates account creation logic, including generating unique account names and codes, and mapping account types to their IDs and enum representations.

classes.name: FeignAccountHelper
classes.description: A helper class for creating and retrieving accounting accounts via Fineract's Feign client.

methods.name: createAssetAccount
methods.description: Creates an asset account with the specified name.

methods.name: createLiabilityAccount
methods.description: Creates a liability account with the specified name.

methods.name: createIncomeAccount
methods.description: Creates an income account with the specified name.

methods.name: createExpenseAccount
methods.description: Creates an expense account with the specified name.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Internal method to handle creating an account of a specific type with unique name and code generation.

methods.name: getAccountTypeId
methods.description: Returns the numeric ID for a given account type string.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the enum representation of the account type based on string input.
